headline: Elastic describes a guarded agent harness for performance optimization
summary: In a September 11 engineering post, Elastic described atune, a harness for agent-assisted Elasticsearch optimization. It separates broad workload exploration from bounded patch tasks, routes work through human-approved benchmarks, compares candidate and baseline forks under matched conditions, and requires statistical and end-to-end checks before a change is accepted for human review. The post documents the design and its intended gates, not measured optimization outcomes; Elastic said examples and results would follow in part two, which was not located in this review.
